20260413_0001_key: What is the oldest university in the world?
20260413_0001_answer: The University of al-Qarawiyyin in Morocco, founded in 859 AD, is recognized by the Guinness Book of World Records as the oldest university!
20260413_0002_key: What is the largest organ in the human body?
20260413_0002_answer: The skin, covering about 1.5-2 square meters and weighing 3-4 kg, is the largest organ. It regulates body temperature and protects against the outside world!
20260413_0003_key: Which country was Cleopatra the queen of?
20260413_0003_answer: Cleopatra VII was the last pharaoh of the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt. Interestingly, she was of Greek descent!
20260413_0004_key: Which country has the most islands in the world?
20260413_0004_answer: Sweden has over 220,000 islands, making it the country with the most islands in the world!
20260413_0005_answer: The Miranda warning requires police to inform suspects of their right to remain silent and right to an attorney upon arrest. It originated from a 1966 U.S. Supreme Court ruling!
20260413_0006_answer: Stagflation is the worst-case economic scenario where stagnation (economic slowdown) and inflation (rising prices) occur simultaneously!
20260413_0007_key: What should you do first when someone is suspected of having a heart attack?
20260413_0007_answer: When a heart attack is suspected, immediately call emergency services (911), request an AED, and begin CPR!
20260413_0008_key: How can you prevent blisters from new shoes?
20260413_0008_answer: Applying petroleum jelly (Vaseline) to friction-prone areas reduces rubbing between skin and shoes, helping prevent blisters!
20260413_0008_opt3: Apply petroleum jelly to friction areas
20260413_0008_opt4: Soak your feet in cold water
20260413_0009_key: What kind of malicious software is 'ransomware'?
20260413_0009_answer: Ransomware encrypts your files and demands payment (ransom) in exchange for the decryption key!
20260413_0009_opt1: Software that secretly collects personal data
20260413_0009_opt2: Software that encrypts files and demands payment
20260413_0009_opt3: Software that slows down your computer
20260413_0009_opt4: Software that forces ads to display
20260413_0010_key: What is the best-selling video game of all time?
20260413_0010_answer: Minecraft has sold over 230 million copies, making it the best-selling video game in history!
20260413_0011_key: How long does it take for caffeine to kick in?
20260413_0011_answer: Caffeine is absorbed into the bloodstream within about 15-45 minutes after consumption, and that's when you start feeling alert!
20260413_0012_answer: The Barnum effect is when people believe vague, general statements apply specifically to them. Horoscopes are a classic example!
20260413_0012_opt1: Believing vague descriptions are uniquely about you
20260413_0012_opt2: Blindly conforming to the majority opinion
20260413_0013_key: Where is most of the world's freshwater stored?
20260413_0013_answer: About 69% of Earth's freshwater is frozen in glaciers and ice caps. Less than 1% of all freshwater is actually accessible for human use!
20260413_0014_key: What is the core technology behind chatbots?
20260413_0014_answer: Natural Language Processing (NLP) is the AI technology that enables computers to understand and generate human language — it's the foundation of chatbots!
20260413_0015_key: What seasoning is essential in sushi rice?
20260413_0015_answer: Sushi rice ('shari') is made by mixing cooked rice with vinegar, sugar, and salt. The vinegar gives it its distinctive tangy flavor and helps preservation!
20260413_0016_key: What is the diameter of a table tennis ball?
20260413_0016_answer: A regulation table tennis ball has a diameter of 40mm and weighs about 2.7g. It was changed from 38mm to 40mm in the year 2000!
20260413_0017_key: What is the shape of our Milky Way galaxy?
20260413_0017_answer: The Milky Way is a barred spiral galaxy, with a bar-shaped structure at its center and several spiral arms extending outward!
20260413_0018_answer: Hummingbirds are the only birds that can hover in place and fly backwards. They can beat their wings up to 80 times per second!
20260413_0018_opt2: They can hover and fly backwards
20260413_0019_key: Who is known as the 'Father of the Symphony'?
20260413_0019_answer: Joseph Haydn composed 104 symphonies and established the standard form of the symphony, earning him the title 'Father of the Symphony'!
20260413_0020_key: Which writing system has the most letters in the world?
20260413_0020_answer: The Khmer script (Cambodia) has 74 letters, earning a Guinness World Record for the largest alphabet!
20260413_0021_key: How many time zones is the world divided into?
20260413_0021_answer: The Earth is divided into 24 standard time zones, each covering 15 degrees of longitude. Some countries use half-hour or quarter-hour offsets!
20260413_0022_answer: Schrödinger's cat is a thought experiment illustrating quantum superposition — before observation, the cat is both alive and dead at the same time!
20260413_0023_key: In what year did the Berlin Wall fall?
20260413_0023_answer: The Berlin Wall fell on November 9, 1989, paving the way for German reunification. It was a symbolic end to the Cold War!
20260413_0024_key: In which country is Machu Picchu located?
20260413_0024_answer: Machu Picchu is an ancient Inca city located at 2,430 meters in the Andes Mountains of Peru. It's a UNESCO World Heritage Site!
20260413_0025_answer: Divide 72 by your annual interest rate to estimate how many years it takes to double your money. For example, at 6% it takes about 12 years!
20260413_0025_opt2: Time for an investment to double
20260413_0026_key: What should you do first when you find someone drowning?
20260413_0026_answer: Jumping in is extremely dangerous. First call emergency services, then throw a flotation device or reach out with a pole!
20260413_0026_opt1: Jump in and rescue them directly
20260413_0026_opt2: Call emergency services and throw rescue equipment
20260413_0026_opt4: Wait for the water to recede
20260413_0027_key: How do you safely remove super glue from your hands?
20260413_0027_answer: Soaking in warm soapy water for 10-15 minutes softens the glue. Acetone (nail polish remover) is also effective!
20260413_0028_key: Where is 'cloud storage' data actually stored?
20260413_0028_answer: Cloud data is physically stored on servers in massive data centers located around the world!
20260413_0029_key: Who is the artist behind the most-streamed song on Spotify?
20260413_0029_answer: The Weeknd's 'Blinding Lights' has been streamed over 4 billion times on Spotify, setting an all-time record!
20260413_0030_key: What makes up the largest percentage of the human body?
20260413_0030_answer: About 60-70% of an adult human body is water. The brain is about 75% water, and blood is about 83% water!
20260413_0031_key: What psychological concept is most related to 'people-pleasing'?
20260413_0031_answer: The need for approval is a psychological pattern where people suppress their own emotions and comply with others to gain recognition!
20260413_0032_key: What is the main cause of ocean acidification?
20260413_0032_answer: When atmospheric CO₂ dissolves in seawater, it forms carbonic acid, lowering the pH. This interferes with shell formation in corals and shellfish!
20260413_0033_key: What do black tea, green tea, and oolong tea have in common?
20260413_0033_answer: All three come from the same plant — Camellia sinensis. The difference lies in how much the leaves are oxidized!
20260413_0033_opt2: They all come from the same tea plant
20260413_0034_key: What is the oldest Olympic sport?
20260413_0034_answer: The stadion (a short sprint) was the only event at the first ancient Olympics in 776 BC, making running the oldest Olympic sport!
20260413_0035_key: Why do astronauts get taller in space?
20260413_0035_answer: In microgravity, the discs between vertebrae expand, making astronauts up to 5 cm taller. They return to normal height back on Earth!
20260413_0036_answer: Seahorses are unique in nature — the male carries and gives birth to the young from a special brood pouch on his belly!
20260413_0037_key: Which Renaissance painter created 'The Birth of Venus'?
20260413_0037_answer: Sandro Botticelli's 'The Birth of Venus,' painted around 1485, is a masterpiece of the Renaissance housed in the Uffizi Gallery in Florence!
20260413_0038_key: What language does the word 'emoji' come from?
20260413_0038_answer: Emoji comes from the Japanese '絵文字' (e-moji), meaning 'picture character.' They were first created in Japan in 1999!
20260413_0039_key: In which city is the International Olympic Committee (IOC) headquartered?
20260413_0039_answer: The IOC has been headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland since 1915!
20260413_0040_key: Do different parts of the tongue taste different flavors?
20260413_0040_answer: The 'tongue map' is actually a myth! All areas of the tongue can detect all five basic tastes!
20260413_0040_opt1: Yes, different areas taste different flavors
20260413_0040_opt2: No, all areas can taste all flavors
20260413_0041_key: Who is considered the first computer programmer?
20260413_0041_answer: Ada Lovelace wrote algorithms for Charles Babbage's Analytical Engine in 1843, making her the world's first computer programmer!
20260413_0042_key: What was the Taj Mahal originally built for?
20260413_0042_answer: The Taj Mahal is a mausoleum built by Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan for his beloved wife Mumtaz Mahal. It took 22 years to complete!
20260413_0043_key: When was the Universal Declaration of Human Rights adopted?
20260413_0043_answer: The UDHR was adopted by the UN General Assembly on December 10, 1948. This date is celebrated annually as Human Rights Day!
20260413_0044_key: What is the biggest difference between an SSD and an HDD?
20260413_0044_answer: SSDs use semiconductor chips with no moving parts, making them much faster, more shock-resistant, and quieter than HDDs!
20260413_0045_key: What's the difference between probiotics and prebiotics?
20260413_0045_answer: Probiotics are live beneficial microorganisms (like lactobacillus), while prebiotics are dietary fibers that feed those good bacteria!
20260413_0045_opt1: They're different names for the same thing
20260413_0045_opt2: Probiotics are microbes; prebiotics feed those microbes
20260413_0045_opt4: Probiotics are vitamins; prebiotics are minerals
20260413_0046_key: What is the compound that makes chili peppers spicy?
20260413_0046_answer: Capsaicin is the chemical compound responsible for the spicy heat in chili peppers. Spiciness is measured on the Scoville scale (SHU)!
20260413_0047_key: Why do sloths sometimes appear green?
20260413_0047_answer: Algae and moss grow on sloth fur, providing natural camouflage and even some nutrients!
20260413_0047_opt2: Algae and moss grow on their fur
20260413_0048_key: How much does one teaspoon of a neutron star weigh?
20260413_0048_answer: Neutron stars are incredibly dense — a single teaspoon would weigh about 6 billion tons!
20260413_0049_answer: Moore's Law observes that the number of transistors on a chip roughly doubles every two years. Gordon Moore proposed it in 1965!
20260413_0049_opt2: Transistor count doubles about every 2 years
20260413_0050_key: What is the most produced fruit in the world?
20260413_0050_answer: Bananas are the most produced fruit, with over 100 million tons annually. India is the largest producer!
20260413_0051_key: Why do we see lightning before we hear thunder?
20260413_0051_answer: Light travels at about 300,000 km/s while sound only moves at about 340 m/s — that's roughly 880,000 times faster!
20260413_0051_opt1: Lightning occurs at a higher altitude
20260413_0051_opt2: Light is much faster than sound
20260413_0052_key: Which of these was NOT traded on the Silk Road?
20260413_0052_answer: Silk, spices, gemstones, and ceramics were all traded on the Silk Road. Oil is a modern industrial commodity!
20260413_0053_key: Does copyright require registration to take effect?
20260413_0053_answer: Copyright is automatically granted the moment a work is created — no registration needed. Registration mainly helps as evidence in disputes!
20260413_0053_opt4: It must be renewed every 5 years
20260413_0054_answer: The Bitcoin whitepaper was published in 2008 under the pseudonym Satoshi Nakamoto. Their true identity remains unknown to this day!
20260413_0055_key: What's the best charging habit for smartphone battery longevity?
20260413_0055_answer: Lithium-ion batteries last longest when kept between 20-80%. Avoid draining to 0% or keeping at 100% for extended periods!
20260413_0055_opt1: Always drain to 0% then charge to 100%
20260413_0056_key: What was Disney's first feature-length animated film?
20260413_0056_answer: 'Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs' (1937) was the world's first full-length cel-animated feature film!
20260413_0056_opt1: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
20260413_0057_answer: Cognitive dissonance is the psychological discomfort felt when your beliefs and actions contradict each other. People tend to change their thoughts or behaviors to resolve it!
20260413_0057_opt1: Discomfort when beliefs and actions conflict
20260413_0057_opt4: A defense mechanism that suppresses emotions
20260413_0058_answer: El Niño occurs when sea surface temperatures in the equatorial Pacific rise more than 0.5°C above normal, causing extreme weather worldwide!
20260413_0058_opt2: Abnormally high Pacific equatorial sea temperatures
20260413_0059_key: What nationality was the scientist who first discovered umami?
20260413_0059_answer: In 1908, Japanese professor Kikunae Ikeda discovered glutamic acid in kelp and proposed umami as the fifth basic taste!
20260413_0060_key: In freestyle swimming, can you use any stroke?
20260413_0060_answer: Freestyle technically allows any stroke. However, since the front crawl is the fastest, virtually all swimmers use it!
20260413_0061_key: How many hearts does an octopus have?
20260413_0061_answer: An octopus has 3 hearts — one main heart pumps blood through the body, and two branchial hearts pump blood through the gills!
20260413_0062_key: What is the lowest string on a standard-tuned guitar?
20260413_0062_answer: The 6th string (thickest) is tuned to E. Standard guitar tuning from low to high is E-A-D-G-B-E!
20260413_0063_key: Which field does NOT have a Nobel Prize?
20260413_0063_answer: The Nobel Prize covers Physics, Chemistry, Medicine, Literature, Peace, and Economics — but not Mathematics. The Fields Medal is the top math award!
20260413_0064_key: In which direction does the Earth rotate?
20260413_0064_answer: Earth rotates from west to east (counterclockwise when viewed from above the North Pole). That's why the Sun appears to rise in the east!
20260413_0065_key: Which country has the most official languages?
20260413_0065_answer: South Africa has 11 official languages, including Zulu, Xhosa, Afrikaans, and English!
20260413_0066_key: Which open-source license is the most permissive?
20260413_0066_answer: The MIT License allows nearly unrestricted use, modification, and distribution, making it one of the most permissive open-source licenses!
20260413_0067_key: What is the most natural way to get vitamin D?
20260413_0067_answer: UVB rays from sunlight trigger vitamin D synthesis in your skin. About 15-30 minutes of sun exposure is usually sufficient!
20260413_0068_answer: Cai Lun of China's Han Dynasty created modern paper from bark and rags around 105 AD. While papyrus existed earlier, true paper originated in China!
20260413_0069_key: What is the correct order for using a fire extinguisher?
20260413_0069_answer: Remember PASS: Pull the pin, Aim the nozzle, Squeeze the handle, and Sweep side to side!
20260413_0070_key: What does 'extra virgin' mean for olive oil?
20260413_0070_answer: Extra virgin olive oil is produced from the first cold pressing of olives, with an acidity of 0.8% or less — it's the highest quality!
20260413_0070_opt2: Highest-grade oil from the first cold press
20260413_0071_key: When was Pluto reclassified as a dwarf planet?
20260413_0071_answer: In 2006, the International Astronomical Union (IAU) redefined what constitutes a planet, and Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet!
20260413_0072_answer: USB stands for Universal Serial Bus. First introduced in 1996, it's now used in virtually every electronic device!
20260413_0073_key: What is the purpose of a honeybee's waggle dance?
20260413_0073_answer: The waggle dance is how honeybees communicate the direction and distance of food sources to their hive mates!
20260413_0073_opt4: To show loyalty to the queen
20260413_0074_key: What type of language is a 'creole'?
20260413_0074_answer: A creole is a stable, full language that developed from a pidgin (a simplified contact language) when it becomes a community's native tongue. Haitian Creole is a well-known example!
20260413_0074_opt2: A contact language that became a native language
20260413_0075_answer: The bystander effect is when individuals are less likely to help someone in need when other people are present — responsibility feels diffused!
20260413_0075_opt2: Less likely to help when others are present
20260413_0076_answer: Short selling means borrowing shares and selling them first, then buying them back at a lower price to profit from the difference!
20260413_0076_opt2: Borrowing shares to sell, then buying back at a lower price
20260413_0077_key: How can you heat food evenly in a microwave?
20260413_0077_answer: Arrange food in a donut shape (hollow in the center) so microwaves distribute more evenly for uniform heating!
20260413_0077_opt1: Use maximum power for a short time
20260413_0077_opt2: Arrange food in a donut shape
20260413_0078_key: Why do 'cookie consent' pop-ups appear on websites?
20260413_0078_answer: Privacy laws like the EU's GDPR require websites to obtain user consent before using cookies to track browsing behavior!
20260413_0079_key: When did the manga 'ONE PIECE' begin serialization?
20260413_0079_answer: Eiichiro Oda's 'ONE PIECE' started serialization in Weekly Shōnen Jump in 1997. It's one of the best-selling manga series ever!
20260413_0080_key: What role does melatonin play in the human body?
20260413_0080_answer: Melatonin is a sleep hormone produced by the pineal gland in the brain. Its secretion increases in darkness, helping induce sleepiness!
20260413_0081_answer: Greenwashing is when companies or products falsely advertise themselves as environmentally friendly when they're actually not!
20260413_0081_opt2: Misleading marketing that fakes environmental friendliness
20260413_0082_key: What does a 'turkey' mean in bowling?
20260413_0082_answer: A turkey in bowling is three consecutive strikes. Four in a row is called a 'four-bagger,' and five is a 'five-bagger'!
20260413_0082_opt3: Knocking down all pins at once
20260413_0083_key: Why can't we see the far side of the Moon from Earth?
20260413_0083_answer: The Moon's rotation period equals its orbital period (about 27.3 days), so the same side always faces Earth. This is called 'tidal locking'!
20260413_0083_opt2: Its rotation and orbital periods are the same
20260413_0083_opt3: The far side is too dark
20260413_0084_key: Which pop art icon painted the Campbell's Soup Cans?
20260413_0084_answer: Andy Warhol's Campbell's Soup Cans series (1962) became an iconic work that brought pop art into the mainstream!
20260413_0085_key: Which blood type is called the 'universal donor'?
20260413_0085_answer: O-negative blood can be given to anyone, earning it the title 'universal donor.' AB-positive, on the other hand, is the 'universal recipient'!
20260413_0086_answer: The Doppler effect is the change in frequency of a wave due to relative motion between the source and observer. An ambulance siren is a classic example!
20260413_0086_opt2: Wave frequency changing due to motion
20260413_0087_key: Which country has the longest coastline in the world?
20260413_0087_answer: Canada has approximately 200,000 km of coastline, the longest of any country in the world!
20260413_0088_key: In which city is the International Court of Justice (ICJ) located?
20260413_0088_answer: The ICJ is located at the Peace Palace in The Hague, Netherlands. It is the principal judicial organ of the United Nations!
20260413_0089_key: Which grain contains the most gluten?
20260413_0089_answer: Wheat has the highest gluten content among grains. Gluten is the protein that gives dough its elasticity and chewy texture!
20260413_0090_key: What is the largest living creature on Earth?
20260413_0090_answer: The blue whale can reach about 30 meters long and weigh up to 150 tons — the largest animal ever to have lived on Earth!
20260413_0091_key: What does the 'G' in '5G' stand for?
20260413_0091_answer: The 'G' stands for Generation. 5G is the 5th generation of mobile networks, offering speeds up to 20 times faster than 4G!
20260413_0092_key: In which country was the Magna Carta created?
20260413_0092_answer: In 1215, King John of England was forced by barons to sign the Magna Carta, the first constitutional document limiting royal power!
20260413_0093_key: What should you NEVER do for someone with hypothermia?
20260413_0093_answer: Rubbing the limbs or putting them in hot water can cause cold blood to rush to the heart, potentially triggering cardiac arrest!
20260413_0093_opt3: Vigorously rub their arms and legs
20260413_0094_key: What is the most famous principle of Gestalt psychology?
20260413_0094_answer: 'The whole is greater than the sum of its parts' is the core principle of Gestalt psychology. Our brains perceive overall patterns before individual elements!
20260413_0094_opt1: The whole is greater than the sum of its parts
20260413_0095_key: Which country has the most trees in the world?
20260413_0095_answer: Russia has about 642 billion trees, the most of any country. It accounts for roughly 20% of the world's forests!
20260413_0096_key: What does the 'Fi' in 'Wi-Fi' actually stand for?
20260413_0096_answer: Wi-Fi doesn't actually stand for anything! It was a marketing term inspired by 'Hi-Fi' (High Fidelity). 'Wireless Fidelity' is not the official meaning!
20260413_0096_opt2: A marketing term with no specific meaning
20260413_0097_key: What is the most powerful piece in chess?
20260413_0097_answer: The queen can move any number of squares horizontally, vertically, or diagonally, making it the most powerful piece on the board!
20260413_0098_key: What is famously considered the shortest complete English sentence?
20260413_0098_answer: 'I am.' (or 'Go.') is one of the shortest complete English sentences with a subject and verb!
20260413_0099_key: What is the most visited city in the world?
20260413_0099_answer: Bangkok welcomes over 22 million international tourists annually, making it the world's most popular tourist destination!
20260413_0100_key: What percentage of DNA do all humans share?
20260413_0100_answer: All humans share about 99.9% identical DNA. The remaining 0.1% accounts for individual traits like eye color and skin tone!
